decision.reason: [ev-525d11df6567] gives only general support rules: each minor gets 6 months, and the last minor after a new major gets 2 years "(starting with v3)". The excerpt is cut off at "Previous …". It does not give the v3.0.0 release date, does not state the 2026-09-07 end date, and does not say that v2 is end-of-life or that new vulnerabilities are fixed only in v3. It is also unclear whether "starting with v3" covers v2.11. So the proposed deprecation consequence and its high severity cannot be checked. We need the rest of the releases page (the "Previous …" rule and the per-version support table with v2.11's end-of-support date), or a v3.0.0 release date to confirm the end-of-life.
